info.title: BreezyHR Jobs API: Open Roles from Any Breezy Career Site
info.description:
Send a company's breezy.hr career page URL, get its open jobs as JSON with salary, remote flag, location and apply link.

Sold on API.market: https://api.market/store/benthepythondev/breezyhr-career-site-jobs (plans, free trial and API key). Call it through the API.market gateway with your API.market key in the x-api-market-key header.

post.description: Current jobs from public BreezyHR career portals: title, company, location, remote flag, employment type, description and apply link. Up to 10 jobs per request, as JSON.

careerUrls.title: BreezyHR career portal URLs
careerUrls.description: Public BreezyHR career portal roots, such as https://there-is-talent.breezy.hr/. You can include more than one company.

query.title: Keywords
query.description: Optional words that must all appear in the title, company, description, employment type or location.

location.title: Location contains
location.description: Optional city, region or country filter.

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Return only jobs marked as telecommute or remote by the employer.

includeDescription.title: Include descriptions
includeDescription.description: Convert each public job description from HTML into clean text.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of jobs to save across all career portals. A request returns 10 rows at most.

201.description: The results, one object per row.

example.title: Reclutador bilingue COLOMBIA ONLY (TT26FT)
example.description: Salary: 3'500.000 COP Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (COL) Contract Type: Independent Contractor Agreement *EXCLUSIVE FOR COLOMBIA* Job Descri...

400.description: The request body does not fit the input fields. The message says which field.
